author: nickyeow

english.text: Please write about your real experience.

jyutping: cing2 nei5 se2 dai1 nei5 ge3 zan1 sat6 ging1 jim6。
text: 請你寫低你嘅真實經驗。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Excuse me, but is this the right way to the subway station?

jyutping: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 aa3，ngo5 soeng2 man6 haa2 ne1 tiu4 lou6 heoi3 m4 heoi3 dou3 dei6 tit3 zaam6 gaa3？
text: 唔好意思呀，我想問吓呢條路去唔去到地鐵站㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I go to the library at least once a week.

jyutping: ngo5 jat1 go3 lai5 baai3 zi3 siu2 heoi3 jat1 ci3 tou4 syu1 gun2。
text: 我一個禮拜至少去一次圖書館。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Japanese is often said to be a difficult language to learn.

jyutping: di1 jan2 seng4 jat6 waa6 jat6 man2 hou2 naan4 hok6。
text: 啲人成日話日文好難學。

author: nickyeow

english.text: A fallen tree obstructed the road.

jyutping: jau5 fo2 syu6 lam3 zo2 lok6 lai4，sak1 zyu6 zo2 tiu4 lou6。
text: 有棵樹冧咗落嚟，塞住咗條路。

english.text: We bought a pound of tea.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 maai5 zo2 jat1 bong6 caa4。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What does your car look like?

jyutping: nei5 gaa3 ce1 hai6 dim2 joeng2 gaa3？

jyutping: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 hai2 dou6 jing2 soeng2 aa3？

jyutping: nei5 soeng6 ci3 gyun1 cin2 hai6 gei2 si4？

author: kaenif

jyutping: keoi5 dei6 waa6 wui5 hei2 zo6 daai6 baa3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We have to do the best that we can.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ceot1 zeon6 cyun4 lik6 zou6 dou3 zeoi3 hou2。
text: 我哋要出盡全力做到最好。

author: nickyeow
jyutping: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 hou2 geng1。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It is the 8th of June of 2013. There have been repeated attempts at reforming Esperanto throughout its history. It began with the Ido schism in 1907. But all attempts have failed because they steered away from the nearly perfect artistic balance of the original. The original really has balance. So, Esperanto lives on despite that there exist what reform-minded people would think are imperfections. Almost everyone prefers the genuine Esperanto.

jyutping: gam1 jat6 hai6 2013 nin4 6 jyut6 8 hou6。sai3 gaai3 jyu5 hai2 keoi5 ge3 lik6 si2 soeng6 jat1 zik6 dou1 jau5 do1 ci3 soeng4 si3 goi2 gaak3 sai3 gaai3 jyu5。keoi5 jau4 1907 nin4 ge3 ji1 do1 fan1 lit6 hoi1 ci2。daan6 hai6 so2 jau5 soeng4 si3 dou1 sat1 baai6 zo2，jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 pin1 lei4 zo2 jyun4 zok3 ge3 gan6 fu4 jyun4 mei5 ge3 ngai6 seot6 ping4 hang4。jyun4 baan2 zan1 hai6 jau5 ping4 hang4，so2 ji5，sai3 gaai3 jyu5 jing4 jin4 cyun4 zoi6，zeon2 gun2 jau5 goi2 gaak3 zyu2 ji6 ge3 jan4 wui5 gok3 dak1 hai6 m4 jyun4 mei5 ge3 dei6 fong1。
text: 今日係2013年6月8號。世界語喺佢嘅歷史上一直都有多次嘗試改革世界語。佢由1907年嘅伊多分裂開始。但係所有嘗試都失敗咗，因為佢哋偏離咗原作嘅近乎完美嘅藝術平衡。原版真係有平衡，所以，世界語仍然存在，儘管有改革主義嘅人會覺得係唔完美嘅地方。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It is now the 1st of November of 2014. I opine that Lulu Islanders just do not understand how important Halloween is. Halloween allows us to face the theme of death with humour and feasting. It celebrates the colours orange, black, and purple. Halloween springs from very ancient traditions, both Xtian and pagan. An encyclopedia could tell one about its mysterious beginnings.

jyutping: ji4 gaa1 hai6 2014 nin4 11 jyut6 1 hou6。ngo5 jing6 wai4 lou6 lou6 dou2 jan4 zi2 hai6 m4 ming4 baak6 maan6 sing3 zit3 jau5 gei2 gam3 zung6 jiu3。maan6 sing3 zit3 ling6 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 jung6 jau1 mak6 tung4 sing6 jin3 heoi3 min6 deoi3 sei2 mong4 ni1 go3 zyu2 tai4。keoi5 hing3 zuk1 caang2 sik1、hak1 sik1 tung4 zi2 sik1 ge3 ngaan4 sik1。maan6 sing3 zit3 hai6 jyun4 zi6 fei1 soeng4 gu2 lou5 ge3 cyun4 tung2，mou4 leon6 hai6 Xtian ding6 hai6 ji6 gaau3。jat1 bun2 baak3 fo1 cyun4 syu1 ho2 ji5 waa6 bei2 jan4 zi1 keoi5 ge3 san4 bei3 hoi1 ci2。
text: 而家係2014年11月1號。我認為露露島人只係唔明白萬聖節有幾咁重要。萬聖節令我哋可以用幽默同盛宴去面對死亡呢個主題。佢慶祝橙色、黑色同紫色嘅顏色。萬聖節係源自非常古老嘅傳統，無論係 Xtian 定係異教。一本百科全書可以話畀人知佢嘅神秘開始。
